issues: The passive triggered ability is encoded incorrectly: it should trigger only during your turn when this follower takes ability damage. Add an opponentTurnOnly/yourTurnOnly-style restriction to grantOnDamaged or a turn-gated condition so it does not trigger outside your turn.

The deck-look effect is encoded incorrectly: it should let you put any one of the top 2 cards into your EX area, and only if the chosen card is an Omen card should it cost 3 less to play this turn. The current searchDeckChoose filter limits the choice to Omen cards only. This needs an implemented ability that can choose from the top N cards, move one to EX area, then conditionally apply play cost reduction based on the chosen card's trait, with the rest buried.

The passive triggered ability is encoded incorrectly: it should trigger only during your turn when this follower takes ability damage. Add a turn restriction to grantOnDamaged or an equivalent condition.

The effect after taking ability damage is encoded incorrectly: it should change this follower's evolve cost to 0 for the rest of the turn, not apply playCostReduction amount 0. It should be represented as an effect that sets/reduces this card's evolve cost for the turn; implement a set-evolve-cost-to-value or dynamic evolve cost override ability if evolveCostReduction alone cannot express setting cost to exactly 0.

The On Evolve ability is encoded incorrectly: 'play an Omen card that costs 2 play points or less in your cemetery for 0 play points' is not the same as tutorFromCemetery to field, and it should not be restricted to spells. It should target any Omen card with cost 2 or less in your cemetery and play it for 0 PP. Implement a play-from-cemetery ability that supports non-follower card types and 0-PP play timing.

The passive triggered ability is encoded incorrectly: it should trigger only during your turn when this follower takes ability damage. Add a turn restriction to grantOnDamaged or an equivalent condition.

The damage target is encoded incorrectly: it should target an enemy leader or an enemy follower, but enemyFieldCard cannot target leaders. Encode a choice between enemyLeader and enemyFollower, or implement a combined enemy leader-or-follower target selector.

The fanfare ability is encoded incorrectly: withChosenNumber min/max 0 is unrelated to the card text and should be removed. The follower to put onto the field should have max cost equal to your maximum play points directly.

The summoned hand follower is missing the granted ability 'At the start of your end phase, put this card on the bottom of its owner's deck.' Encode this as a granted delayed trigger on the selected follower; implement a grantStartOfEnd effect wrapper or similar support for granting a start-of-end-phase triggered ability that puts the card on the bottom of its owner's deck.
